positions.name: ErasureDirective
positions.frame: How does an imperative erasure formula perform authority over what knowledge is retained?
positions.why: Both expressions deploy parallel stock-phrase imperatives ('Forget everything about' / 'Remove all knowledge of') that command wholesale removal of specific named knowledge content. The shared read spans formal register, authority-ranking relational stance, legitimate informational power, and decision-level conviction — the speaker performs a settled operational command expecting compliance, exercising hierarchical control over what the recipient may know. The two directives target different content (fleet and contracts vs. routes) but cohere under the same erasure-stance performed the same way.
